description: This file implements a storage interface for Kubernetes using etcd v3 as backend, including methods for CRUD operations, listing, watching, resource version management, and resource size estimation.

classes.name: store
classes.description: Implements the storage.Interface for Kubernetes using etcd v3 as backend.

classes.name: objState
classes.description: Represents the current state of an object in storage, including metadata, revision, data, and staleness.

classes.name: abortOnFirstError
classes.description: Error aggregator that aborts on the first encountered error during list operations.

methods.name: RequestWatchProgress
methods.description: Requests progress for a watch operation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes resources associated with the store.

methods.name: Versioner
methods.description: Returns the versioner used for resource version management.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an object from storage by key.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new object in storage.

methods.name: GuaranteedUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update with guaranteed concurrency control.

methods.name: Stats
methods.description: Returns storage statistics, including object count.

methods.name: EnableResourceSizeEstimation
methods.description: Enables resource size estimation for the store.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys under the resource prefix.

methods.name: ReadinessCheck
methods.description: Performs a readiness check of the storage backend.

methods.name: GetCurrentResourceVersion
methods.description: Returns the current resource version of the stored objects.

methods.name: GetList
methods.description: Lists objects under a given key prefix.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Establishes a watch on a key prefix.
